newsitem.title: UK: GM's Vauxhall to invest 300 mln stg in UK.
newsitem.headline: GM's Vauxhall to invest 300 mln stg in UK.

text.p: General Motors Corp's UK unit Vauxhall Motors Ltd confirmed on Tuesday that it is to invest 300 million stg upgrading its Ellesmere Port Astra car plant in north-west England.

Vauxhall's chairman and managing director Nick Reilly told reporters at the British International Motor Show in Birmingham that the investments, which is the company's largest ever in the UK, would "underpin the long term future of the plant."
He added that this was "a huge vote of confidence in Vauxhall by General Motors."

The modernisation of the plant, which also makes vans, will allow Vauxhall to increase production capacity to 160,000 vehicles a year from present capacity of 145,000. The phased, three-year plan to re-equip and reorganise its entire assembly operation at Ellesmere Port had already begun, Reilly said.
"Reilly said that if Astra sales continued to grow the investment could potentially create up to 200 extra jobs at the plant over time.
He said if Vauxhall was able to add a third work shift at Ellesmere Port "the number of new jobs would further significantly increase."
